brief: A Cairo marketplace app where home cooks sell fresh meals to nearby customers; orders, payouts and reviews in one place.

evidence.title: Product one-pager
evidence.content: Scope: pilot with 50 users. Success: 80% of target workflows completed in-app without phone support. Constraints: launch before the semester starts; no stored card data.

evidence.title: Ops constraints memo
evidence.content: Budget covers one engineer and one designer for 3 months. All data must stay on local hosting. Support channel is WhatsApp-first; email secondary.

requirements.text: The system shall let a home cook publish a daily menu with quantities before 10:00.
The system shall show each order's payment state (pending/paid) to the cook.
The system shall notify the customer when an order is delayed by more than 15 minutes.
The system shall verify a review only after the corresponding delivery is confirmed.
The system shall compute a 5% platform commission on each completed payout.
Cooked-food listings shall expire automatically at 23:59 the same day.
